Scene/backdrop: night sky above Caelune filled with sparse converging vowlines in Caelune, an original city of pearl-stone crescent districts suspended above a deep blue cloud sea by living luminous roads.
Characters: Sola Merrow, fictional adult woman age 38, tall athletic working build and mature proportions, warm brown skin, long dark auburn hair in a low segmented braid with one silver forelock, deep navy practical pathwright coat with ivory piping, ochre scarf, slate trousers and boots; copper oath bracer until broken; never sexualized; Tarin Kest, fictional adult man age 45, broad mature build, deep umber skin, short tightly curled black hair silver at both temples, pearl-gray practical warden coat over muted teal layers, dark trousers and boots; long ivory spear-key until broken; never sexualized; Kesin Or, fictional adult nonbinary archivist age 52, compact mature build, light olive skin, shaved head, round amber spectacles, plum-gray layered archive jacket, ink-dark gloves and satchel; never sexualized; a small group of visibly mature fictional adults serving as city.

Composition/framing: top-to-bottom chronology; one dominant focal subject and no more than two competing actions per frame; simple low-detail backgrounds except when the frame establishes geography; large readable gestures and silhouettes; naturally quiet open areas, but never draw a box for text.
Chronological frames:
Frame 1: Establish night sky above Caelune filled with sparse converging vowlines with sola, tarin, kesin, fictional_adult_city; make current geography and emotional condition immediately legible.
Frame 2: Concrete objective: Bind the independent promises without taking ownership; show an adult initiating a specific next step.
Frame 3: Escalation becomes visible: The lines converge on Sola and threaten to crown her as sole controller.
Irreversible visible state already in force: tarin_arrested, sola_hold_chord_burned_out, tarin_badge_broken, tarin_freed, tarin_spear_shattered, sever_cost_identified_as_sola_office, tarin_promises_partnership_beyond_utility, sola_accepts_identity_beyond_office, sola_unlocks_sever_chord, sola_pathwright_office_relinquished, sola_copper_bracer_broken, tarin_chorus_fork_forged, tarin_rejects_weaponized_authority, sola_arm_reinjury_warn.

Constraints: all humans are explicitly fictional adults with unmistakably mature proportions; preserve named identity, hair, clothing, injury, equipment, and relationship state; coherent hands and anatomy; clear cause and effect; disciplined light; at most one cyan-gold oath effect per frame; source art contains no final lettering.
